content: Composer (acquired by SoFi June 2026, now 'Composer by SoFi'): NL-to-strategy AI builder + visual no-code drag-drop 'symphony' editor, backtesting vs benchmarks, automated execution and rebalancing via own brokerage. ~$32/mo, no annual discount. Notably ENDED crypto asset and crypto-indicator support after 2026-01-31; users had to update or liquidate crypto symphonies. Signal: the no-code AI strategy builder category retreated from crypto toward regulated equities/ETFs.
